01-03.text: Pope John XXIII excommunicates Fidel Castro.

03-01.text: Titanic becomes the first film to gross over $1 billion worldwide.

03-02.text: Cardinal Eugenio Pacelli is elected Pope and takes the name Pius XII.

06-01.text: Tennessee was admitted as the 16th state of the United States.

06-02.text: Queen Elizabeth II was crowned at Westminster Abbey in London.

10-01.text: Croatian War of Independence: The Siege of Dubrovnik begins.
